(1) Final/accepting structure: FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty; u2 is declared in STATES and is reached exactly when door_open first holds in u1, which is the task's success condition; its else self-loop keeps acceptance stable for the rest of the episode. (2) Semantic fidelity and ordered coverage: the chain u0 --has_door_key--> u1 --door_open--> u2 mirrors the environment-enforced order (door_open cannot become true before has_door_key), so every achievable 'open the door' trajectory is accepted and no episode that never opens the door reaches u2. Requiring the key as an explicit intermediate state loses no language (door_open implies has_door_key happened earlier, even if the key was dropped in between, since u1's else absorbs the gap) and enables a legitimate progress reward. (3) Irrelevant events and per-state else self-loops: every state has an else self-loop. key_lost (an event, correctly read) can fire in u1 when the key is dropped before opening and is absorbed with no reward; re-pickup of the key in u1 is likewise absorbed without re-paying 0.1; target_picked_up is unreachable before u2 (it requires door_open) but is still covered by else; u2's else absorbs later door_open reversal via toggle and any target_picked_up, matching the reachability reading of the task. (4) Reward safety and density: 0.1 for the necessary key subgoal and 1.0 for the goal are each delivered at most once; there are no rewarding self-loops and no path from u1/u2 back to u0/u1, so neither reward can be farmed (toggling the door shut after opening cannot re-trigger the 1.0); total is bounded at 1.1, and 0.1 is the maximum available density since no other proposition changes during navigation. (5) Regressions: none are required here — regressing u1 to u0 on key_lost would re-pay the key reward and create a farming risk, and post-goal door_open reversal is correctly absorbed by the accepting u2 self-loop. (6) Predicate-only: only environment propositions (has_door_key, door_open) are used; persistent/event kinds are respected (door_open used as a one-shot trigger, the irrelevant event key_lost ignored). (7) Format: matches the paper artifact layout — REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION headers complete, explicit transitions paired with else self-loops, rewards keyed by (state, proposition, state) with zero entries implied. No changes needed.
